title: GRAPH contract graph-runtime/v0.2
description: Requests, results, hypothesis candidates and projection snapshots of GRAPH (Graph Runtime for Analysis, Provenance, Hypotheses). Each is a definition under $defs; graph_runtime.json_schema(name) gives a schema for one of them.

id.description: An original ID, relation or type, as the consumer gave it.

exact.description: An exact non-negative rational, p or p/q in lowest terms.

request.description: A normalized request, as graph_runtime.normalize_request writes it and a result echoes it. An input request may leave out contract, mode, limits (or any limit), max_depth and a typed path's targets, which normalization fills.

via.description: null at depth 0, else the hop that first reached the node (the allOf below says which)

shortest_answer.description: cost_exact and lower_bound_exact appear when the request's costs include a float (rational mode); there, cost and lower_bound are the nearest floats, or null when the exact value is beyond the floats. lower_bound appears in an interrupted answer.

code.description: unsupported: unsupported_operation, unsupported_mode, unsupported_contract, negative_cost; failed: invalid_request, invalid_cost, non_finite_cost, unknown_node, unknown_relation, unknown_node_type, unknown_edge, missing_cost, unrepresentable_result, internal_error; stale_snapshot: projection_mismatch, bindings_changed

timing.description: Wall-clock seconds by phase; not part of result_id.

result.description: The runtime additionally checks digests, normalized request identity and binding, counts, limits, exact arithmetic, and witness structure. verify_result checks witnesses against input records; it does not prove completeness or minimality.

time.description: ISO 8601 date or date-time; real calendar dates and chronology are checked by the runtime.

hypothesis_candidate.description: A hypothesis candidate record. What JSON Schema cannot check (the digests, a generated id, unique test and assessment ids, a revision history) graph_runtime.validate_candidate and verify_revisions check. Calendar validity, chronology, distinct observations and plain JSON extension keys are also checked by the runtime.

type_parents.description: A hierarchy: each name's parents (acyclic); names without parents are left out.

relation_parents.description: A hierarchy: each name's parents (acyclic); names without parents are left out.

projection.description: A projection snapshot (Projection.to_dict); its identity is recomputed from the records on reading.
